title: AnalogScout: Simulation-Efficient PVT-Aware Analog Sizing with LLM Agents
title_zh: AnalogScout：基于LLM智能体的仿真高效、PVT感知的模拟电路尺寸设计

paragraphs.en: Analog device sizing must satisfy all specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners to ensure tape-out success, but simulating every candidate at all corners dominates the sizing time and slows design iteration. Conventional surrogate-based optimizers search the sizing space directly, while recent large language model (LLM) agents add circuit knowledge to designs but still delegate the sizes to global optimizers. Both learn the circuit response from repeated multi-corner SPICE simulations and optimize on top of it, which becomes expensive under a limited simulation budget. Providing an agent with reusable verified designs and sizing sub-blocks analytically could save most of this budget. We propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework driven by an LLM agent. Combining elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing and global refinement under full-corner verification, AnalogScout reduces power by 43.3% relative to the evolution strategy CMA-ES at an equal budget of 16k simulations on three SKY130 OTAs of increasing complexity, and reaches the final CMA-ES power after 7.0% of that budget. It also attains lower power than Bayesian optimization on all three OTAs and than two re-implemented LLM-driven flows on the two OTAs where they were tested.

paragraphs.en: Analog design automation lags far behind its digital counterpart, and device sizing remains its most labor-intensive step [ 1 ] . Sizing selects the widths, lengths and bias currents that meet gain, bandwidth, stability and noise targets at minimum power. In advanced nodes these targets must hold at every process, voltage and temperature (PVT) corner, so each candidate costs a full multi-corner SPICE sweep.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟设计自动化远远落后于其数字对应领域，而器件尺寸确定仍然是最耗人力的步骤 [ 1 ] 。 尺寸确定需要选择宽度、长度和偏置电流，以在最小功耗下满足增益、带宽、稳定性和噪声指标。 在先进工艺节点中，这些指标必须在每个工艺、电压和温度（PVT）角点下都成立，因此每个候选方案都需要进行一次完整的多角点 SPICE 扫描。

paragraphs.en: PVT-aware sizing searches for device sizes that satisfy all specifications at all corners, mainly through surrogate-based and population-based optimization. Surrogate methods such as Bayesian optimization (BO) fit the corner-dependent response [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] , whereas evolutionary and reinforcement-learning methods [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] search the design space corner by corner [ 8 , 9 ] . Both learn the response from sampled simulations, so their cost scales with corners times iterations (Sec. II ).

paragraphs.en: LLM agents [ 10 , 11 ] add circuit knowledge to this search but spend the simulation budget poorly (Fig. 1 ). LLM-only sizing loops oscillate between solutions [ 12 ] , and most agentic flows delegate every device size to a global optimizer [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . We further observe that agents re-submit identical designs, restart instead of refining verified ones, and lose most of the budget to simulation-driven local optimizers. An agent that reuses verified designs and sizes sub-blocks analytically would instead spend its budget on improving designs.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体[10,11]为这种搜索增加了电路知识，但对仿真预算的使用并不合理（图1）。 仅用LLM的尺寸设计循环在多个解之间振荡[12]，且大多数智能体流程将每个器件尺寸都委托给全局优化器[13,14,15,16]。 我们进一步观察到，智能体会重复提交相同的设计，重新开始而非改进已验证的设计，并将大部分预算消耗在仿真驱动的局部优化器上。 相反，一个能复用已验证设计并以解析方式确定子模块尺寸的智能体，会将预算用于改进设计。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by agentic exploration in digital RTL design [ 17 ] , we propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework, with three contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 受数字 RTL 设计中智能体式探索 [17] 的启发，我们提出了 AnalogScout，一个面向仿真的高效、PVT 感知的尺寸设计框架，其主要贡献有三：

paragraphs.en: Budget-aware exploration: an elite pool and an exact evaluation cache let the agent refine verified designs instead of repeating or restarting them.
paragraphs.zh: 预算感知的探索：精英池与精确评估缓存让智能体得以改进已验证的设计，而不是重复或重启它们。

paragraphs.en: Low-simulation local sizing: the agent states gm/Id goals for sub-blocks, which a lookup-table solver resolves with at most three operating-point simulations per block.
paragraphs.zh: 低仿真局部尺寸设计：智能体为各子模块设定 gm/Id 目标，由一个查找表求解器解决，每个模块最多只需三次工作点仿真。

paragraphs.en: Results: on three SKY130 OTAs verified at nine corners, AnalogScout reduces power by 43.3% relative to CMA-ES at an equal 16k-simulation budget, matches the final CMA-ES power after 7.0% of that budget, and on the Miller and NMC OTAs beats CMA-ES with twice the budget.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：在九个工艺角下验证的三个 SKY130 OTA 上，在相同的 16k 次仿真预算下，AnalogScout 相比 CMA-ES 将功耗降低了 43.3%，仅用该预算的 7.0% 即可达到 CMA-ES 的最终功耗水平，并且在 Miller OTA 和 NMC OTA 上以一半的预算击败了 CMA-ES。

paragraphs.en: AnalogScout is a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework in which an LLM agent decides where and toward which goal to size, while deterministic tools compute the sizes and verify the design (Fig. 2 ). Its input is a topology with starting sizes, the specifications, a PDK and a simulation budget; it seeks a netlist that meets every specification at every PVT corner with low typical-corner power. In Phase-Explore the agent rewrites the netlist, starting from the best verified designs so far; in Phase-Localize it attaches gm/Id goals to sub-blocks, which a lookup-table solver resolves. Phase-Restructure then swaps standard sub-circuits within their family, and Phase-Refine spends the remaining budget on a global search around the best design before sign-off.
paragraphs.zh: AnalogScout 是一个仿真高效、PVT 感知的尺寸设计框架，其中一个 LLM 智能体决定在何处以及朝着什么目标进行尺寸设计，而确定性工具负责计算尺寸并验证设计（图 2）。 其输入是一个带初始尺寸的拓扑、规格指标、PDK 和仿真预算；它寻求一个在每个 PVT 角下都满足所有规格、且典型角功耗低的网表。 在探索阶段（Phase-Explore），智能体从迄今最优的已验证设计出发改写网表；在定位阶段（Phase-Localize），它为子模块附加 gm/Id 目标，由查找表求解器求解。 重构阶段（Phase-Restructure）随后在同族标准子电路之间进行替换，而精调阶段（Phase-Refine）则将剩余预算用于在签核前围绕最优设计进行全局搜索。

paragraphs.en: Budget and seeds. Every method receives 16k simulations, where one simulation is one SPICE run of one testbench at one corner in ngspice [ 30 ] , and only evaluations completed within the budget count. AnalogScout allots 8k simulations to Phase-Explore (60 agent runs of up to 30 steps on deepseek-flash [ 25 ] ), 4k to Phase-Localize, 2k to Phase-Restructure and the remainder to Phase-Refine. We fixed the method and three hypotheses on development seeds 1–3 and report confirmation seeds 4–8, five per OTA and three for GF180.
paragraphs.zh: 预算与种子。 每种方法获得 16k 次仿真，其中一次仿真是在 ngspice [30] 中对某一测试平台在某一工艺角进行的一次 SPICE 运行，且只有在该预算内完成的评估才计入。 AnalogScout 为探索阶段（Phase-Explore）分配 8k 次仿真（在 deepseek-flash [25] 上进行 60 次智能体运行，每次最多 30 步），为定位阶段（Phase-Localize）分配 4k 次，为重构阶段（Phase-Restructure）分配 2k 次，其余分配给精化阶段（Phase-Refine）。 我们在开发种子 1–3 上固定了该方法和三个假设，并在确认种子 4–8 上报告结果，其中 OTA 每种五个、GF180 每种三个。

sents.en: AnalogScout allots 8k simulations to Phase-Explore (60 agent runs of up to 30 steps on deepseek-flash [ 25 ] ), 4k to Phase-Localize, 2k to Phase-Restructure and the remainder to Phase-Refine.
sents.zh: AnalogScout 为探索阶段（Phase-Explore）分配 8k 次仿真（在 deepseek-flash [25] 上进行 60 次智能体运行，每次最多 30 步），为定位阶段（Phase-Localize）分配 4k 次，为重构阶段（Phase-Restructure）分配 2k 次，其余分配给精化阶段（Phase-Refine）。

sents.en: We fixed the method and three hypotheses on development seeds 1–3 and report confirmation seeds 4–8, five per OTA and three for GF180.
sents.zh: 我们在开发种子 1–3 上固定了该方法和三个假设，并在确认种子 4–8 上报告结果，其中 OTA 每种五个、GF180 每种三个。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. Global CMA-ES [ 26 ] and BO [ 31 , 32 ] size all devices from the starting design with the same bound handling and restarts as Phase-Refine, and CMA-ES is also run with twice the budget. LAS-style [ 16 ] and ACP-style [ 13 ] baselines let the LLM propose a design and hand its sizes to a global optimizer on the same evaluator. H1 tests AnalogScout against CMA-ES at equal budget, H2 Phase-Localize against an equal-budget restart from the same designs, and H3 Phase-Explore with and without the elite pool; all are one-sided and Holm-corrected at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 .
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 全局 CMA-ES [26] 和 BO [31, 32] 从初始设计出发对所有器件进行尺寸优化，采用与 Phase-Refine 相同的边界处理和重启机制，并且 CMA-ES 还以两倍的预算运行。 LAS 风格 [16] 和 ACP 风格 [13] 的基线方法让 LLM 提出一个设计，并将其尺寸交给同一个评估器上的全局优化器。 H1 在相同预算下将 AnalogScout 与 CMA-ES 进行比较，H2 将 Phase-Localize 与从相同设计出发的等预算重启进行比较，H3 对比有无精英池的 Phase-Explore；所有检验均为单侧检验，并在 α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 水平上进行 Holm 校正。

paragraphs.en: At the same 16k-simulation budget, AnalogScout reaches the lowest power of all methods on every OTA (Table I ). It reduces power by 43.3% relative to CMA-ES (H1, Holm-adjusted p = 9.16 × 10 − 6 p=9.16\times 10^{-6} ), and on every OTA each of its five searches beats each CMA-ES search. On the Miller and NMC OTAs, it still reaches 42.4% and 39.0% lower power than CMA-ES with 32k simulations. The convergence curves in Fig. 5 show that AnalogScout matches the final CMA-ES power after 694–1,124 simulations, about 7.0% of the budget.
paragraphs.zh: 在相同的 16k 仿真预算下，AnalogScout 在每个 OTA 上都达到了所有方法中最低的功耗（表 I）。 相对于 CMA-ES（H1，经 Holm 校正的 p = 9.16 × 10 − 6 p=9.16\times 10^{-6}），它将功耗降低了 43.3%，并且在每个 OTA 上，它的五次搜索中的每一次都优于 CMA-ES 的每一次搜索。 在 Miller 和 NMC OTA 上，使用 32k 仿真时，它仍比 CMA-ES 达到低 42.4% 和 39.0% 的功耗。 图 5 中的收敛曲线表明，AnalogScout 在 694–1,124 次仿真后即可达到 CMA-ES 的最终功耗，约占预算的 7.0%。

paragraphs.en: The ablation in Table I traces this efficiency to reusing verified designs. With the elite pool, Phase-Explore reaches 18.1% lower power than with fresh starts only at 8k simulations (H3, p = 0.00022 p=0.00022 ). On development seeds, Phase-Localize spends only 4.3% of its simulations on sizing, against 85.3–96.3% for a simulation-based local optimizer, and evaluates about twelve times more designs within the same 4k simulations. At equal budget, however, it shows no significant power reduction over restarting from the same designs (H2, p = 0.645 p=0.645 ), so we claim its low simulation use, not a power gain. Phase-Restructure leaves the median power unchanged, and Phase-Refine lowers it by at most a further 2.4%.
paragraphs.zh: 表 I 中的消融实验将这种效率归因于对已验证设计的复用。 借助精英池，Phase-Explore 在 8k 次仿真时比仅从全新设计开始的情况功耗低 18.1%（H3，p = 0.00022 p=0.00022）。 在开发种子上，Phase-Localize 仅将 4.3% 的仿真用于尺寸设计，而基于仿真的局部优化器则需要 85.3–96.3%，并且在同样的 4k 次仿真内多评估约十二倍的设计。 然而，在相同预算下，相比从相同设计重新开始，它并未表现出显著的功耗降低（H2，p = 0.645 p=0.645），因此我们主张的是其低仿真用量，而非功耗增益。 Phase-Restructure 使中位功耗保持不变，Phase-Refine 则最多再降低 2.4%。

paragraphs.en: AnalogScout’s designs pass independent all-corner re-measurement about as often as CMA-ES’s. Independent scripts re-measure 156 reference cases from all methods; 46 fail. Per method, 29 of AnalogScout’s 111 cases fail, as do 3 of CMA-ES’s 12, 2 of BO’s 11 and 14 of the LLM baselines’ 31 (shared cases count for each). Forty of the failures only miss the 50 mV all-corner saturation margin, which the loop checks at the typical corner only; the other 6 exceed a specification by at most 0.5%. Among the best designs, which also undergo typical-corner mismatch Monte Carlo ( N = 500 N=500 ), the SKY130 Miller design is signed off, the folded-cascode design fails the re-measurement and reaches a 91.4% Monte Carlo yield (target 95%), and the NMC design misses the 170 ns settling specification by 0.15% at one corner. On GF180MCU, AnalogScout reduces Miller OTA power by 59.6% versus CMA-ES, and its best design is signed off with a 99.8% Monte Carlo yield.
paragraphs.zh: AnalogScout 的设计通过独立全工艺角复测的频率与 CMA-ES 大致相当。 独立脚本对来自各方法的 156 个参考案例进行复测；其中 46 个失败。 按方法划分，AnalogScout 的 111 个案例中有 29 个失败，CMA-ES 的 12 个中有 3 个失败，BO 的 11 个中有 2 个失败，LLM 基线的 31 个中有 14 个失败（共享案例在各方法中分别计入）。 40 个失败仅因未满足 50 mV 全工艺角饱和裕度（该裕度仅在典型工艺角由环路检查），其余 6 个超出规格不超过 0.5%。 在同样经过典型工艺角失配蒙特卡洛分析（N=500）的最优设计中，SKY130 米勒设计通过签核，折叠共源共栅设计未通过复测且蒙特卡洛良率为 91.4%（目标 95%），NMC 设计在一个工艺角上以 0.15% 之差未达到 170 ns 建立时间规格。 在 GF180MCU 上，与 CMA-ES 相比，AnalogScout 将米勒 OTA 的功耗降低了 59.6%，其最优设计以 99.8% 的蒙特卡洛良率通过签核。

paragraphs.en: AnalogScout sizes analog circuits across PVT corners budget-efficiently by refining verified designs and resolving local sizing intent with almost no simulations. Future work will resize blocks analytically after structural changes and check saturation at all corners inside the loop; the code and open-PDK data will be released.
paragraphs.zh: AnalogScout 通过细化已验证的设计并解决局部尺寸调整意图，几乎无需仿真即可在 PVT 角下以高性价比的方式完成模拟电路的尺寸设计。 未来的工作将在结构变更后以解析方式重新调整模块尺寸，并在循环内检查所有工艺角下的饱和情况；相关代码和开放 PDK 数据将会发布。
